- Accounting: credits applied as a line-item offset on the first invoice(s); we will attach a one-page addendum to the Master Services Agreement (no license changes).

Attached: NovaLabs-Redwood-Proposal-v2.pdf (proposal + usage schedule).

Next steps: if this looks good, procurement can confirm and we will circulate an addendum + DocuSign link. Happy to hop on a 15-min call with procurement to walk through the billing note.

Thanks — Ben
